title: Design: a tier's name is renamed in place, Esc cancels
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Point at tier A's name.
  4. Click the pencil.
  5. Type a new name no other tier uses.
  6. Press Esc.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • A pencil shows beside the name while the pointer is over it, as in picture 2.33.

Step 4:

  • The name becomes an outlined field with the hint "Press Enter or click away to save. Esc cancels." under it, as in picture 2.35.

Step 5:

  • The field shows the new name.

Step 6:

  • The field closes and the title shows tier A's old name.
